headline: Intrasoft Technologies files AGM scrutinizer's report for Sept 2026 meeting
hook: AGM voting results submitted to exchanges
summary: Intrasoft Technologies Limited has officially submitted the scrutinizer's report of its Annual General Meeting held on September 29, 2026, to the stock exchanges. This routine regulatory filing documents the formal voting results and shareholder approvals from the company's annual gathering. Retail investors holding shares in the micro-cap firm can review the compliance filing for corporate governance records. The filing has negligible impact on broader market indices or retail portfolios.
why_it_matters: Routine corporate governance filing with no direct impact on retail portfolios.
